EnableSettingsTab.description: Enables the settings tab on block elements in the backoffice.

StoragePath.description: Path relative to ContentRootPath where block filter config files are stored. Useful when running on a read-only filesystem or when a custom location is required.

AllowedBlockPlacementParentContentIds.description: Optional list of parent content IDs whose children are offered in the block placement dropdown, in addition to the real root nodes.

AllowedDocumentTypeAliases.description: Optional list of document type aliases used to filter the items already shown in the block placement dropdown.
